occupations.name: Soldier
occupations.description: You served in an army or militia, trained in combat and military tactics. War shaped you into what you are today.

occupations.name: Merchant
occupations.description: You bought and sold goods, traveling trade routes and negotiating deals. Coin and commerce were your trade.

occupations.name: Sailor
occupations.description: You worked on ships, whether as crew, navigator, or captain. The sea was your workplace and sometimes your battlefield.

occupations.name: Farmer
occupations.description: You worked the land, growing crops or raising livestock. Your life was dictated by seasons and weather.

occupations.name: Criminal
occupations.description: You made your living outside the law—as a thief, smuggler, or con artist. The shadows were your domain.

occupations.name: Entertainer
occupations.description: You performed for crowds—as a musician, actor, dancer, or storyteller. You lived to bring joy or provoke emotion.

occupations.name: Scholar
occupations.description: You dedicated yourself to study and research, whether in a university, library, or on your own. Knowledge was your pursuit.

occupations.name: Priest
occupations.description: You served a deity or faith, ministering to the faithful and performing sacred rites. Your life was one of devotion.

occupations.name: Artisan
occupations.description: You crafted goods with your hands—whether as a blacksmith, carpenter, weaver, or other tradesperson. Your skill was your living.

occupations.name: Hunter
occupations.description: You tracked and killed game for food and pelts, living off the land. The wilderness was your hunting ground.

occupations.name: Guard
occupations.description: You protected people or places—as a city guard, bodyguard, or caravan escort. Your job was to stand watch and keep others safe.

occupations.name: Miner
occupations.description: You worked underground, extracting ore and gems from the earth. The darkness and danger of the mines tested you daily.

occupations.name: Herbalist
occupations.description: You gathered and prepared plants for medicine and potions. Your knowledge of nature's remedies was sought after.

occupations.name: Scribe
occupations.description: You copied documents, kept records, or wrote letters for others. Your skill with words and writing was valuable.

occupations.name: Gambler
occupations.description: You made your living through games of chance and skill, taking risks for reward. Lady Luck was your patron.

occupations.name: Guide
occupations.description: You led others through dangerous or unfamiliar territory, using your knowledge of the land to keep them safe.

occupations.name: Gladiator
occupations.description: You fought for sport and spectacle in arenas, your life a constant battle for survival and glory.

occupations.name: Spy
occupations.description: You gathered information and secrets for those who paid you, working in the shadows to uncover what others wished to hide.

occupations.name: Wanderer
occupations.description: You had no fixed occupation, drifting from place to place and taking odd jobs. Freedom was more important than stability.

occupations.name: Noble
occupations.description: You were born or elevated to nobility, your occupation one of politics, management of estates, or military command.

occupations.name: Armorsmith
occupations.description: You hammered plate, riveted mail, and stitched padding into armor that kept soldiers alive. Every dent you repaired told a story.

occupations.name: Weaponsmith
occupations.description: You forged blades, axeheads, and spear tips at a hot forge. You know a good weapon by its weight and balance.

occupations.name: Toolsmith
occupations.description: You made and mended the hammers, saws, and plowshares that everyone else depended on. Practical work, done well.

occupations.name: Barber
occupations.description: You cut hair, trimmed beards, and pulled the occasional tooth. Your chair was where the town came to talk.

occupations.name: Cook
occupations.description: You worked a kitchen, feeding crowds with whatever ingredients you could get. Long hours over a hot fire made you tough.

occupations.name: Forager
occupations.description: You wandered fields and forests gathering mushrooms, roots, and berries. You know what is safe to eat and what will kill you.

occupations.name: Gravedigger
occupations.description: You dug graves and buried the dead, rain or shine. Few things in this world can unsettle you anymore.

occupations.name: Composter
occupations.description: You hauled and tended the refuse heaps that fed the fields. It was filthy work, but you learned how the soil lives.

occupations.name: Acrobat
occupations.description: You tumbled, balanced, and flipped for coin, trusting your body to land every time. Gravity is more of a suggestion to you.

occupations.name: Apothecary
occupations.description: You mixed tinctures, salves, and powders behind a shop counter. Healers and the sick alike came to you for remedies.

occupations.name: Architect
occupations.description: You drew up plans for houses, halls, and bridges, then watched them rise. You see structure and weakness in everything.

occupations.name: Artist
occupations.description: You sketched, sculpted, and painted, chasing beauty wherever you found it. Patrons were fickle, but your eye never was.

occupations.name: Astrologer
occupations.description: You charted the stars and planets and read meaning in their movements. Some called it science, others called it nonsense.

occupations.name: Bowyer
occupations.description: You shaped staves and strung bows for hunters and soldiers. You can judge a bow by the sound of its string.

occupations.name: Brewer
occupations.description: You malted grain and tended vats of ale and beer. Your work kept taverns full and spirits high.

occupations.name: Brick Layer
occupations.description: You laid brick and mortar, course by course, building walls meant to last generations. Your back remembers every one.

occupations.name: Candlemaker
occupations.description: You rendered tallow and poured wax into candles that lit homes and temples alike. Patient, careful work.

occupations.name: Carpenter
occupations.description: You cut, joined, and raised timber into homes, furniture, and barns. A steady hand and a sharp saw were your living.

occupations.name: Cartographer
occupations.description: You surveyed roads and coastlines and drew them onto maps. You always know which way is north.

occupations.name: Tailor
occupations.description: You cut, stitched, and mended clothing for anyone who could pay. A good fit was your pride.

occupations.name: Diplomat
occupations.description: You negotiated treaties and soothed tempers between rival powers. Words were your weapons, and you wielded them carefully.

occupations.name: Dyer
occupations.description: You boiled roots, bark, and minerals into dyes and soaked cloth in vibrant color. Your hands were never quite clean.

occupations.name: Engineer
occupations.description: You designed and maintained machines, mills, and siege works. Gears and levers make more sense to you than people.

occupations.name: Engraver
occupations.description: You carved fine lines into metal, wood, and stone, from signet rings to grave markers. Precision is second nature.

occupations.name: Fisherman
occupations.description: You cast nets and lines from boats and riverbanks, braving cold water for each day's catch. Patience fed your family.

occupations.name: Lumberjack
occupations.description: You felled trees and hauled logs from dawn to dusk. Swinging an axe all day built a powerful frame.

occupations.name: Glass Blower
occupations.description: You shaped molten glass into bottles, windows, and delicate ornaments. Heat and timing were everything.

occupations.name: Street Merchant
occupations.description: You hawked wares from a cart or blanket on the roadside, shouting over the crowd. Every sale was a small victory.

occupations.name: Shop Merchant
occupations.description: You ran a shop, keeping stock, ledgers, and customers in order. You know the worth of most things at a glance.

occupations.name: Herald
occupations.description: You carried proclamations and announced arrivals for those in power. Your voice carried the weight of authority.

occupations.name: Innkeeper
occupations.description: You ran an inn, pouring drinks, cooking meals, and keeping the peace among travelers. You have heard every story twice.

occupations.name: Interpreter
occupations.description: You translated between people who could not understand one another. You learned to hear what was meant, not just what was said.

occupations.name: Jester
occupations.description: You entertained a noble court with jokes, juggling, and barbed mockery. Making the powerful laugh is a dangerous art.

occupations.name: Jeweler
occupations.description: You set stones and worked precious metals into rings, brooches, and crowns. Your clients were wealthy and demanding.

occupations.name: Leatherworker
occupations.description: You tanned hides and cut, stitched, and tooled leather into armor, saddles, and boots. The smell never quite left you.

occupations.name: Locksmith
occupations.description: You built, repaired, and opened locks for anyone who needed it. You know every lock has a weakness.

occupations.name: Messenger
occupations.description: You ran letters and parcels across towns and countryside, often at a dead sprint. Speed and stamina were your trade.

occupations.name: Minstrel
occupations.description: You traveled from town to town singing songs, telling stories, and reciting poetry for your supper.

occupations.name: Moneylender
occupations.description: You loaned coin at interest and made sure it came back. You learned to read desperation and dishonesty.

occupations.name: Navigator
occupations.description: You guided ships across open water by stars, charts, and instinct. Getting lost was never an option.

occupations.name: Painter
occupations.description: You painted portraits, murals, and landscapes for patrons and passersby. You notice colors and details others miss.

occupations.name: Physician
occupations.description: You studied the body and treated illness and injury. Many owe their lives to your skill.

occupations.name: Playwright
occupations.description: You wrote plays for the stage, putting words in the mouths of kings and fools alike.

occupations.name: Potter
occupations.description: You threw clay on the wheel and fired it into bowls, jugs, and pots. A steady hand and a calm mind served you well.

occupations.name: Waiter
occupations.description: You served food and drink in taverns and dining halls, balancing trays and tempers. You are good at reading a room.

occupations.name: Servant
occupations.description: You kept a household running, cleaning, fetching, and staying out of sight. You saw much and said little.

occupations.name: Dishwasher
occupations.description: You scrubbed pots and plates in a hot, crowded kitchen for meager pay. Hard work never scared you.

occupations.name: Dentist
occupations.description: You examined, cleaned, and pulled teeth, often to the screams of your patients. Steady hands were a must.

occupations.name: Shipwright
occupations.description: You built and repaired hulls, masts, and rigging. A ship you built is a ship that floats.

occupations.name: Shoe Maker
occupations.description: You cut leather and stitched boots and shoes that carried people across the world.

occupations.name: Stone Carver
occupations.description: You worked chisel and mallet against stone, shaping statues, gargoyles, and masonry. Your patience is carved deep.

occupations.name: Weaver
occupations.description: You worked the loom, turning thread into cloth day after day. The rhythm of the shuttle steadied your mind.

occupations.name: Oracle
occupations.description: You glimpsed the future in visions and omens. People sought your words, though they rarely liked what they heard.

occupations.name: Teacher
occupations.description: You taught children their letters and numbers at a local school. Patience and clarity were your greatest tools.

occupations.name: Student
occupations.description: You were still learning and had no paying work yet. Your head is full of books and big ideas.

occupations.name: Librarian
occupations.description: You cataloged, preserved, and lent out books and scrolls. Quiet hours among the stacks taught you focus.

occupations.name: Recruit
occupations.description: You had only just joined the local militia, with rusty gear and basic drills behind you. Your real training is still ahead.

occupations.name: Squire
occupations.description: You served a knight, tending their arms, armor, and horse in hopes of earning knighthood yourself one day.

occupations.name: Mercenary
occupations.description: You sold your sword to whoever paid best. Loyalty was a contract, and you always collected.

occupations.name: Thief
occupations.description: You lived by stealing what you could and selling what you stole. Quick fingers kept you fed.

occupations.name: Scoundrel
occupations.description: You hustled, cheated, and swindled your way through life. Rules were for people with honest options.

occupations.name: Conman
occupations.description: You preyed on the generosity and greed of others with practiced lies. Every mark was a performance.

occupations.name: Enforcer
occupations.description: You were paid to break up riots, collect debts, and make problems go away. Intimidation was your job.

occupations.name: Crime Boss
occupations.description: You ran your own criminal syndicate, managing thugs, bribes, and rivals. Power came from fear and favors.

occupations.name: Athlete
occupations.description: You competed in races, wrestling, and games for prize money. Your body was your livelihood.

occupations.name: Farmhand
occupations.description: You worked someone else's land, hauling, planting, and tending animals for room and board.

occupations.name: Fletcher
occupations.description: You fletched and fitted arrows by the hundred. Straight shafts and true feathers were your pride.

occupations.name: Butcher
occupations.description: You slaughtered animals and carved them into cuts for market. You know exactly where everything is inside a body.

occupations.name: Courtesan
occupations.description: You entertained wealthy clients with wit, charm, and company. Secrets were often whispered in your presence.

occupations.name: Beggar
occupations.description: You spent your days on the street begging for coins. You learned who would give and who would not.

occupations.name: Tramp
occupations.description: You drifted from place to place, picking up small jobs and sleeping wherever you could. You can survive on very little.

occupations.name: Caravan Merchant
occupations.description: You traveled with caravans from city to city, buying low and selling high. The road was your home.

occupations.name: Tamer
occupations.description: You tamed and trained animals, from hounds to horses to stranger beasts. Creatures trust you.

occupations.name: Veterinarian
occupations.description: You treated sick and injured animals, from farm livestock to prized warhorses.

occupations.name: Actor
occupations.description: You performed on the stage, becoming whoever the script demanded. Pretending is second nature.

occupations.name: Virtuoso
occupations.description: You mastered your instruments and played for the finest audiences. Music is how you speak.

occupations.name: Fortune Teller
occupations.description: You read palms, cards, and tea leaves for curious customers. Whether you truly saw anything is your secret.

occupations.name: Builder
occupations.description: You hauled stone, swung hammers, and raised walls on construction sites. Heavy lifting was your trade.

occupations.name: Stable Master
occupations.description: You ran a stable, caring for horses and managing the hands who worked it. Riders trusted you with their mounts.

occupations.name: Stable Helper
occupations.description: You mucked stalls, hauled feed, and groomed horses at a local stable. Animals were easier company than people.

occupations.name: Poet
occupations.description: You wrote and recited verse, capturing feeling in carefully chosen words.

occupations.name: Captain
occupations.description: You commanded a ship and its crew, making hard calls in storm and battle. Your word was law aboard.

occupations.name: Notary
occupations.description: You witnessed and sealed official documents, contracts, and wills. Details matter to you.

occupations.name: Author
occupations.description: You wrote stories and novels, spending long nights chasing the perfect sentence.

occupations.name: Vigilante
occupations.description: You took justice into your own hands, hunting criminals the law would not touch.

occupations.name: Toy Maker
occupations.description: You crafted toys and clever little contraptions for children. Your workshop was full of springs and gears.

occupations.name: Physician's Assistant
occupations.description: You helped a physician at a local clinic, fetching supplies, holding patients steady, and dressing wounds.

occupations.name: Cheese Maker
occupations.description: You curdled, pressed, and aged cheese, waiting months for each wheel to mature.

occupations.name: Wine Maker
occupations.description: You tended vineyards and fermented grapes into wine. You can taste the year a bottle was made.

occupations.name: Fruit Picker
occupations.description: You climbed trees and picked orchards bare each harvest season for a few coins a basket.

occupations.name: Steward
occupations.description: You managed an estate for its lord, overseeing staff, stores, and accounts.

occupations.name: Accountant
occupations.description: You managed other people's money and balanced their books. Numbers do not lie, but people do.

occupations.name: Banker
occupations.description: You worked in a bank, handling loans, deposits, and the fortunes of the wealthy.

occupations.name: Trainer
occupations.description: You trained others in the art of combat, drilling recruits until the basics became instinct.

occupations.name: Breeder
occupations.description: You bred animals for strength, speed, or temperament. You understand bloodlines better than most nobles.

occupations.name: Assassin
occupations.description: You killed silently and disappeared before the body was found. Few knew your face and fewer lived to describe it.

occupations.name: Historian
occupations.description: You studied the events of the past and the people who shaped them. History repeats, and you are watching.

occupations.name: Justicar
occupations.description: You brought the church's justice to those who wronged it, sword in hand and faith in your heart.

occupations.name: Hitman
occupations.description: You were paid to kill, and you did not ask why. One contract at a time.

occupations.name: Trader
occupations.description: You brokered deals and moved goods between buyers and sellers, always taking your cut.

occupations.name: Monster Hunter
occupations.description: You hunted the beasts and horrors that preyed on common folk. Every scar is a trophy.

occupations.name: Circus Performer
occupations.description: You performed in a traveling circus, dazzling crowds with tricks, stunts, and spectacle.

occupations.name: Handy Man
occupations.description: You fixed whatever was broken, from leaky roofs to squeaky hinges. Odd jobs paid the bills.

occupations.name: Tattoo Artist
occupations.description: You inked designs into skin with needle and pigment. Every client carries a piece of your work.

occupations.name: Fence
occupations.description: You bought stolen goods and sold them on, no questions asked. You know what everything is worth and who wants it.

occupations.name: Pirate
occupations.description: You sailed under a black flag, raiding ships and coastal towns for plunder.

occupations.name: Poacher
occupations.description: You illegally hunted valuable game on lands that were not yours. You learned to stay quiet and unseen.

occupations.name: Theologian
occupations.description: You studied scripture, doctrine, and the nature of the divine. Your faith is built on knowledge.

occupations.name: Bodyguard
occupations.description: You were hired to protect someone important, standing between them and any threat.

occupations.name: Royal Guard
occupations.description: You guarded a member of the royal family, sworn to give your life for theirs.

occupations.name: Inquisitor
occupations.description: You hunted the enemies of the church, rooting out heresy and the dark things that hide among the faithful.

occupations.name: Investigator
occupations.description: You were hired to solve mysteries, following clues others overlooked until the truth came out.

occupations.name: Monk
occupations.description: You lived in a monastery, devoting yourself to discipline, meditation, and simple labor.

occupations.name: Knight
occupations.description: You were anointed as a knight and swore a vow to your order. Honor and duty define you.
